articles.title: Dimeco (OTCPK:DIMC) Q3 Earnings Spotlight A Stronger Profit Engine
articles.summary: Dimeco came into this Q3 2026 report with a quiet reputation as a small regional bank that simply grinds out earnings. The latest numbers cut through that calm. Basic earnings per share reached about $2.40 and net income landed near $6.14 million, yet the stock only moved about 4.2% higher to $66.69 on the first trading day after the release.
